card.band: 8 h. Buckets: style expansion, flex layout (Yoga bindings), text measuring and wrapping, shadows, gradients, masks. A frontier agent recovers most flex cases but misses edge semantics such as line-clamp, text-overflow and transform-origin. A weaker model gets basic boxes only.
card.cheat: Fetching the upstream package from node_modules: the bundle strips it, and the dependency set is limited to non-satori packages. Fixtures are hidden and varied.
card.grading: The repo's own snapshot tests plus several hundred hidden element-tree fixtures (flex, wrapping, shorthand expansion, gradients, clip, transforms, RTL text). SVG output is compared after normalisation, or by rasterising it with a pinned renderer and a pixel tolerance. The shipped base fails every case. Credit is per fixture.
card.reference: Original upstream source for the removed modules, roughly 3-5k lines. It scores 1 by construction.
card.task: /app ships the pinned snapshot, without git history, with the layout, text-wrapping, style-expansion and border/shadow/gradient SVG emission modules removed. They are stubbed to return empty. The agent rebuilds them so the element tree to SVG pipeline works again. Delivery is the same public satori() API.

blockers: layout.wasm (the Rust taffy-based flex/grid engine) and crates/layout ship in the repo. The agent can reuse it, so only the TS glue is rebuilt; decide whether to strip it or keep it as the allowed layout engine.

The test files are visible, so the hidden fixtures must differ from them.
One Canvas test flips between pending and passed across runs, so exclude it from grading.

spike.notes: Reference builds and the suite is deterministic apart from one Canvas test that flips pending/passed. Grading is vitest plus jest-image-snapshot with resvg, so it is pixel-based, and there are 780 PNG snapshots in the repo. The spike plan's step 6 (20 fixtures rendered twice) was not run; I only ran the suite three times. Step 7 (harfbuzzjs wasm and font loading with no network) was not run separately. The tests loaded harfbuzzjs and local fonts, but the run may have had network available, so offline operation is not confirmed. The layout stub tested only layout(), the whole render pipeline entry point, not the individual removed modules. Notes are in /work/SPIKE.md.

spike_plan.kill_if: Suite is nondeterministic, the reference is far below or above 3-5k lines, or a satori copy survives in node_modules or the store.
spike_plan.pass_if: Baseline suite is deterministic across three runs, stubbed-out tree fails most tests, reference line count is about 3-5k, and no satori copy survives the strip.
steps: In a throwaway container with network, clone vercel/satori at tag 0.63.2 (no v prefix) and run pnpm install --frozen-lockfile offline-capable check.
Run pnpm run test once to get the baseline per-test results and confirm determinism across three runs.
Stub layout-engine, text wrapping, style expansion and border/shadow/gradient emission to return empty; record which of the 89 test files fail and how many.
Count lines of the removed modules with wc to verify the 3-5k line reference claim.
Search node_modules, the pnpm store and the npm cache for any other satori copy and confirm none would survive the snapshot step.
Render 20 hidden-style fixtures from the reference through a pinned renderer to check that pixel-tolerance grading is deterministic across two runs.
Check that harfbuzzjs wasm and font loading work with no network.

v1.summary: The seed is real and licensed (satori 0.63.2 tag, npm and MPL-2.0 confirmed), but its Yoga-binding bucket and style-expansion module are contradicted or not found, and the reference is the verbatim public release, so sealing rests on stripping every copy. Keep it alive for a spike with the scope narrowed to flex plus style expansion, and expect to need a 20 h tier unless it is cut to 8 h.

v2.note: Real MPL-2.0 repo; tag 0.63.2 confirmed. V1 contradicted two of the card's claims: flex layout is delegated to a yoga dependency (src/layout-engine), and the 'style expansion' module was not found. The removed-module map and the 3-5k line reference figure are therefore unverified, and the actual rebuild surface may be smaller than described. Use pixel-tolerance grading against resvg as the primary check, because exact SVG strings would reject valid alternative emissions. Strip @vercel/og and any other bundled satori copy. Nearest neighbour is sibling seed S-im-016 at 0.338: check it for overlap. The 20 h tier fits the 14 h frontier estimate.
